lion.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet, nine separated cutouts arranged in a strict 3 columns by 3 rows grid.
Reference image: identity and painted fur style of this exact golden lion with dark brown flowing mane and white muzzle. Maintain the reference's proportions, palette, face and tail.
All FULL BODY animals face LEFT in strict side profile except the final head portrait. No objects, ground, pool, log, vines, shadows, mud droplets, text, labels or background. Actual transparent alpha. Generous transparent gutters, no touching silhouettes.
Row 1 left: careful slow balancing walk, body lowered, three paws firmly planted, one front paw cautiously lifted. Row 1 center: complementary careful walk step, other front paw cautiously planted, hind paw lifted, tail balancing. Row 1 right: compact airborne leap to the LEFT, forepaws reaching forward, hind legs tucked, full body and tail visible.
Row 2 left: trudging through THICK mud, low body, tense shoulders, forepaw pulling BACK and down with visible muscular effort, heavy legs bent, no drawn mud. Row 2 center: complementary heavy mud step, front paw pulling forward slowly, head strained, abdomen low, bent hind legs pushing. Row 2 right: climbing out up a LEFT bank, torso angled upward 25 degrees, both forepaws extended down-left to grab the bank, hind legs braced lower-right, full body no bank.
Row 3 left: paddling while lying belly-down on a small floating log (do NOT draw the log), forelegs spread to SIDE and DOWN, paws by chest, low stable torso, relaxed rear legs, looking LEFT. Row 3 center: complementary side paddle stroke, paws sweep back low at sides, no raised arms, no running legs. Row 3 right: only a realistic painted HEAD portrait of this exact lion, front three-quarter view, full mane and ears, bust cropped below neck, calm alert expression, detailed eyes and fur matching game character, no badge.
Professional coherent hand-painted 2D jungle game assets, textured fur, rich natural shading, consistent scale and lighting across full body poses, no photorealistic style drift.
